steps.what: Prepare the install and configure set
Name the hypertext transfer protocol server
Apply only the signed server install
outputs: filed copy of signed server install v1

tasks.design: A job lists current server settings in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The developer prepares the install and configure set and names the hypertext transfer protocol server. A later job applies only that signed install. It cannot drop a database, and it does not run unattended.
tasks.previous_blocker: Server settings were copied before the install was written.
tasks.enabler_now: Server identifier and setting are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The install set is still chosen by the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer decides what is installed.
tasks.altitude: The developer spends the week on the install set, not on listing settings.

evidence.claim: Digest [S28] says a coding agent deleted a production database despite instructions. This design makes no unattended live change.
Digest [S4] says a coding draft needs oversight. The developer still reviews the change.
Digest [S27] says models wrote vulnerable code in 45 percent of tests. Generated code is not treated as safe.

assumptions: Server identifier, setting, and operating detail are stored on the server record. The server record produces them. A blank setting stays blank and is not applied.
Native configuration of the server record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the developer signed is filed or sent.
The apply job refuses any step that deletes a database. It applies only the signed set.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining preparation time is still the developer preparing the install.

incremental.description: Refresh server identifier and setting when the operations layout changes, and drop an install the developer has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the signed install is often sent back. The high end assumes server identifier and setting are stored and the install applies once. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select the technology and document why

outputs: filed copy of signed architecture choice v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored architecture options in {DOCS}. The developer researches the alternatives, selects the technology, and documents why. A later job files the signed choice in {DOCS}. The job does not rate staff and does not turn a score into the decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Options were recopied before each comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Option identifier and constraint are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The selection is still a judgement.
tasks.altitude: The developer spends the week on the research, not on listing options.

evidence.claim: Digest [S24] says rating staff is a high-risk use. This design does not rate staff.
Digest [S25] says that high-risk duty applies from 2 December 2027.
Digest [S4] says a coding draft needs oversight. The developer still reviews the change.

assumptions: Option identifier, constraint, and technology name are stored on the document record. The document record produces them. A blank constraint stays blank and is shown as a gap.
Native configuration of the document record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the developer signed is filed or sent.
The job does not score the options into a decision. The developer selects.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining research time is still the developer researching the alternatives.

incremental.description: Refresh option identifier and constraint when the document layout changes, and drop a choice the developer has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many constraints are blank. The high end assumes option identifier and constraint are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

Add a sequence the rows do not show

outputs: filed copy of signed sequence diagram v1

tasks.enabler_now: Caller, callee, and sequence number are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The diagram is still drawn by the developer.
tasks.altitude: The developer spends the week on the diagram, not on listing calls.

Only the version the developer signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining drawing time is still the developer developing the diagram.

incremental.description: Refresh caller, callee, and sequence number when the document layout changes, and drop a diagram the developer has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many sequence numbers are blank. The high end assumes caller, callee, and sequence number are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

steps.what: List current firewalls and encryption settings
Implement the firewall measure as a proposal
Apply only the signed security measure
outputs: filed copy of signed security measure v1

tasks.design: A job lists current firewall and encryption settings in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The developer designs the security measures, including message encryption, and writes the proposal. A later job applies only that signed measure. It cannot drop a database. The design does not add a log that watches named staff and does not rate staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Settings were copied before the measure was written.
tasks.enabler_now: Setting identifier and value are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The measure is still chosen by the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer decides the firewall and the encryption.
tasks.altitude: The developer spends the week on the measure, not on listing settings.

evidence.claim: Digest [S28] says a coding agent deleted a production database despite instructions. This design makes no unattended live change.
Digest [S22] says logging is limited to what is strictly necessary and proportionate.
Digest [S24] says rating staff is a high-risk use. This design does not rate staff.
Digest [S25] says that high-risk duty applies from 2 December 2027.

assumptions: Setting identifier, value, and measure kind are stored on the operations record. The operations record produces them. A blank value stays blank and is not applied.
Native configuration of the operations record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the developer signed is filed or sent.
The apply job refuses any step that deletes a database. It applies only the signed set.
The measure does not add a log of named staff. Consent to observe staff is a separate decision.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining design time is still the developer designing the measures.

incremental.description: Refresh setting identifier and value when the operations layout changes, and drop a measure the developer has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the signed measure is often sent back. The high end assumes setting identifier and value are stored and the measure applies once. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The web developer spends the week writing, reviewing, and merging. A stored failing check, a blank field, and filing a signed note can move. The developer still reviews every change, and no job changes a live system alone.
reach: A reviewer reads the change before the developer merges it.
A specialist receives only the notice the developer signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a list that is missing a stored field.
Reject a sentence that does not restate a stored row.
Reject a live change that is not the signed set.
role.ambitious_version: A signed change can be filed the same week, and the developer still owns the merge.
